_comment: The working calendar every date in the plan is computed against.
Weekends are always non-working. Add org holidays to `holidays` as
YYYY-MM-DD, and per-developer time off under `leave`. Anything listed
here shifts the forecast on the next 09:00 run.
The same holiday list is the input Ayush needs for B-023/B-024 — the
working-hours service every SLA calculation routes through. Keep one
list, not two, or the Gantt and the SLA engine will disagree.
7=Sun, matching `weeklyOff` in the API contract and DayOfWeek.getValue()
in the service. It previously read [0,1,2,3,4] — Python's date.weekday(),
a third numbering next to the API's and JavaScript's. Nothing read it, so
the value was inert; the trap was that B-024 is told to treat this file as
